name: Apple bag
source:
Working the late-night shift as a cashier in a small town, you starts to form good relations with your regulars. Between flirtations and friendly banter, the specter of a mysterious disappearance haunts your nights as you’re exposed to more and more suspicious behaviors. Are your regulars linked to the missing student, and, more importantly, will you secure a Halloween date?

[From [url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/apple-bag]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个小镇当收银员上夜班，你开始与常客建立良好的关系。在调情和友好的玩笑之间，当你接触到越来越多的可疑行为时，神秘失踪的幽灵会困扰你的夜晚。你的常客与失踪的学生有联系吗？更重要的是，你能确保万圣节约会吗？

[来自[url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/apple-bag]itch.io[/url]]
